changes: Bundle exact pure JavaScript dependencies; preserve original source and license notices.
Use the identical Alpha base storage and projection-cache rows rather than inserting duplicates.
Resolve assertNever through the Alpha dsh-util-values export; preserve the exhaustive variant guard.
Read the 12 live Session event collections through snapshotEvents(), preserving query snapshot.events and on-demand readers.

Migrate the removed question provider registration to the official user-questions/request waterfall, preserving the original FIFO, answer, abort and disposal behavior and restricting handling to the owning Agent.
Pass the empty attachment list before the original AbortSignal when executing plain slash commands through the Alpha commands service.
Vendor the exact MIT-licensed fzstd 0.1.1 ESM module and preserve both import call sites.
Keep the complete upstream compiled Notebooks host, client and typed Remote API; bundle the fixed MIT-licensed Zod 4.4.3 dependency.
Resolve DSH services from the fixed Alpha runtime instead of installing old host packages. Remove the unused obsolete client-runtime injector.
Read the live session transcript with snapshotEvents(), retaining the original assistant-output extraction.
Bundle the optional SQLite and HTTP-fetch implementations from the exact MIT-licensed Alpha source d347e703908d0406b7a7ef80e3a0e594d86b2215; preserve their storage routing and request policy checks.

Preserve the complete upstream compiled classroom client and host, prompts and skills. Vendor the unchanged interactive-post-processor.js from the fixed @openmaic/generation 0.3.0 release, which is the only host import used from that dependency.
Remove redundant declarations for dependencies already present in the compiled client and the unused obsolete client-runtime injector.
Bundle the exact Zod 4.5.1 dependency and use the existing Alpha credentials/home-paths services. Preserve all accounting, pricing, balance and provider logic.
Package the original declared lib, cordis.patch.yml and docs/provider-pricing.json runtime files plus license and README; upstream repository screenshots are not part of the declared npm package.
Vendor the complete fixed QuickJS 0.32.0 dependency closure, including all four original sync/async and debug/release WASM variants, licenses and package resolution metadata.
Preserve the original workflow runtime, restricted-source validation, resource limits, native-tool bridge and persistence. Resolve the vendor entry from a private package-relative directory.
